description: Returns the framework’s notes for one jurisdiction, and which stored AI instruments apply to a task in a court or tribunal. Name the forum, or court "no" when no court is involved. A gap means no instrument is stored for that forum.

court.description: no when no court or tribunal is involved.

document_type.description: affidavit, witness-statement, expert-report, submissions, pleadings, contract or chronology.

forum.description: A forum code such as "ncat", "federal-court" or "vcat". Omit it to be asked which court applies.

jurisdiction.description: A jurisdiction id or slug, for example "NSW", "VIC", "new-zealand".

personal_information.description: True when the work puts personal information into an AI product.

task.description: What the work is, in a short phrase. Used to recognise the document and the subject.

name: get_jurisdiction_guidance
title: Get a jurisdiction’s guidance
